spec.description: Path to the spec file, relative to the repo root or absolute. Its text is given to every worker and reviewer.

baseBranch.description: Branch the integration branch is created from. Default: the branch checked out in the repo.

integrationBranch.description: Branch that approved tasks are merged into. Default: orch/integration.

settings.description: Overrides for the orchestrator defaults. Every key is optional.

model.description: Worker model (alias or full id). Default: sonnet.

reviewModel.description: Reviewer and conflict-resolver model. Default: sonnet.

workerType.description: Default worker and reviewer role. Default: coding.

allowedTools.description: Tools the worker may use without a prompt (permission rule syntax, e.g. "Bash(npm *)").

maxAttempts.description: Worker attempts per task before it fails. Default: 3.

maxBudgetUsd.description: Spend cap per claude call in USD. Default: 0 (no cap).

review.description: Run the review agent after tests pass. Default: true.

setup.description: Command run once in each fresh worktree, e.g. "npm ci".

integrationCheck.description: Command run in the integration worktree after each merge. A failure undoes the merge.

commandTimeoutSec.description: Timeout for setup, acceptance and integration commands. Default: 1800.

enforceOwns.description: Reject a task that edits files outside owns + shared. Default: true.

shared.description: Globs any task may edit (lock files, barrel files). Not used for scheduling.

additionalDirectories.description: Existing directories outside the worktree that agents may access. Absolute paths or paths relative to the project root; passed to the CLI as --add-dir. This does not enforce read-only access.

ignore.description: Globs never committed from a worktree (build and tool artifacts). Replaces the default list.

id.description: Unique id. Used in branch names (orch/task/<id>) and folder names.

deps.description: Ids that must be merged before this task starts.

owns.description: Globs (repo-relative, forward slashes) this task may edit. Tasks with overlapping owns never run at the same time. Empty = the whole repo, so the task runs alone.

acceptance.description: Command run with pwsh in the task worktree. Exit code 0 = pass.
